from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class LIS2DW12_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 8  # Register width in bits

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0x20: 0x00,  # CTRL1
            0x21: 0x04,  # CTRL2
            0x23: 0x00,  # CTRL4_INT1_PAD_CTRL
            0x24: 0x00,  # CTRL5_INT2_PAD_CTRL
            0x26: 0x00,  # OUT_T
            0x27: 0x00,  # STATUS
            0x2E: 0x00,  # FIFO_CTRL
            0x2F: 0x00,  # FIFO_SAMPLES
            0x38: 0x00,  # WAKE_UP_SRC
            0x3C: 0x00,  # X_OFS_USR
            0x3D: 0x00,  # Y_OFS_USR
            0x3E: 0x00   # Z_OFS_USR
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if nbytes == 2:
            return self.regs[addr]
        elif nbytes == 1:
            return (self.regs[addr] & 0xFF00) >> 8

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if nbytes == 2:
            self.regs[addr] = data
        elif nbytes == 1:
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0x00FF) | (data << 8)

        # Handle SOFT_RESET field
        if addr == 0x21 and (data & 0x40) != 0:
            # Perform a reset
            self.regs = {
                0x20: 0x00,  # CTRL1
                0x21: 0x04,  # CTRL2
                0x23: 0x00,  # CTRL4_INT1_PAD_CTRL
                0x24: 0x00,  # CTRL5_INT2_PAD_CTRL
                0x26: 0x00,  # OUT_T
                0x27: 0x00,  # STATUS
                0x2E: 0x00,  # FIFO_CTRL
                0x2F: 0x00,  # FIFO_SAMPLES
                0x38: 0x00,  # WAKE_UP_SRC
                0x3C: 0x00,  # X_OFS_USR
                0x3D: 0x00,  # Y_OFS_USR
                0x3E: 0x00   # Z_OFS_USR
            }
